Historic home built in the late 19th century. Home of Rafael Coronel.(modern artist, painter, and son-in-law to Diego Rivera).
Templo de Nuestra Señora de la Asunción
Av. Mexico, Barrio Los Angeles, Villa Milpa Alta

Historic 16th century church with a starkly austere exterior but a spectacular interior with a high arched ceiling on the nave with colorful domes and talavera tile. The church has a number of artworks dating to the viceregal era.
Big steaming bowls of red, white, or green pozole topped with most usual fixin's (onions are typical, but here provided only on request). The avocado tingas are recommended.
